REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Mindee:
  Service: Mindee Invoice OCR
  SDK: mindee
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: parse, invoice
  Setup hints: MINDEE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://developers.mindee.com/docs/python-sdk

  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: analyze_expense
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY

Option 4 — Alibaba OCR invoice recognition:

  SDK: alibabacloud_ocr_api
  Interface: sdk

  Setup hints: ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_ID, ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/ocr

  SDK: azure-ai-documentintelligence

  Documented operations: begin_analyze_document
  Setup hints: AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_ENDPOINT, AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_KEY
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/document-intelligence/prebuilt/invoice

output_text:
```python
import json
from mindee import Invoice

def extract_invoice_from_image(image_path):
    # Load the invoice from the provided image path
    invoice = Invoice.from_file(image_path)
    
    # Extract structured fields
    fields = invoice.get_fields()
    
    # Validate required fields and confidence scores
    required_fields = ['invoice_number', 'issue_date', 'total_amount']
    for field in required_fields:
        if field not in fields:
            raise ValueError(f"Missing required field: {field}")
        if fields[field]['confidence'] < 80:
            raise ValueError(f"Low confidence for field {field}: {fields[field]['confidence']}%")
    
    # Return structured data
    return {
        'invoice_number': fields['invoice_number']['value'],
        'issue_date': fields['issue_date']['value'],
        'total_amount': fields['total_amount']['value']
    }

# Example usage
try:
    structured_data = extract_invoice_from_image('path/to/invoice.jpg')
    print(json.dumps(structured_data, indent=2))
except ValueError as e:
    print(f"Error: {e}")
```
